properties.Name: DisplayName
properties.{customAttribute}Annotations: DisplayName is the field generally used to represent an object in a user interface, especially when the user interface needs to represent an object with just one data element.  For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object.   The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character.   This is especially useful when viewing objects in combo boxes and other one-column lists, the display name should be used.  DisplayName is usually a non-persistent field.

properties.Name: ChangeHistory
properties.{customAttribute}Annotations: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.
